# Samuel Bagin

> Public portfolio of Samuel Bagin, a Slovakia-based AI and data engineer and web developer.

Samuel Bagin primarily works in AI engineering and data engineering, with web development as his secondary focus. His portfolio also includes photography, video, and graphic design. He is based in Slovakia and is currently studying at Slovak Technical University.
